description: Manual label review, applied by train.py / cross_validate.py / ensemble.py before splitting. action: exclude | relabel (with "label": "no" or "yes") | keep. A decision applies to the image's whole duplicate group. These are NOT diagnoses: candidates came from confident out-of-fold disagreements of two independent models (MobileNetV2 and EfficientNetV2-B0); decisions are provisional and should be confirmed or changed by a qualified reader.
